title: Method C Framework Improvements Phase 1(b): Wake-Preserving Progressive Remeshing Re-Issue 2
review_directive: Phase 1(b) Re-Issue 2: Defined RF2 intermediate tolerance (<=10%) and documented systematic stiffening (+5.0% to +15.5%) as physical trade-off; clarified severance scope (Cycle 52 reaches 63.95 mm, 0.05 mm short of 64 mm stopping bound; severance not reached in 4-cycle validation window); committed all 4 PHYS.inp mesh decks under phase1b_wake_preserving_validation/ and switched unit tests to repo-relative paths with 0 hardcoded paths; corrected Cycle 52 baseline to 28,710; flagged Cycle 49 tip distance (0.91 mm) as borderline; 11/11 unit tests PASS. 0 PBS.
